description: MainActivity.java defines the main activity for an Android driver app, handling UI setup, location permissions, location updates, and integrating various Google and Android services for navigation and location tracking.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The primary activity managing UI, navigation, location permissions, and location updates for the driver app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, location permissions, location updates, and navigation.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections such as displaying app info or logging out.

methods.name: checkLocationPermission
methods.description: Checks and requests location permission from the user.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles the result of permission requests.

methods.name: displayLocationSettingsRequest
methods.description: Checks and prompts the user to enable high accuracy location settings.

methods.name: requestStoragePermission
methods.description: Requests storage permissions if not granted.
